verdict.rationale: Fidelity Private Shares is a SaaS equity-management platform, so natural-language operation is a fair axis to ask about. However, every piece of evidence describes click-through workflows, forms, bulk uploads and integrations, with no natural-language command interface, assistant or AI agent. The probes found no llms.txt, markdown docs or OpenAPI spec either, so there is no documented capability to credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
